prompt:
A densely annotated editorial infographic plate, drawn by hand in confident ink
line with light watercolour and gouache wash on bright warm-white paper.
Contour line varies in weight and is charcoal near-black. Dimensional but not
photographic: restrained hatching, subtle texture, believable volume, selective
shadow, clean uncluttered background. Every material reads as itself — dull grey
lead, unglazed earthenware, weathered timber, damp fibrous bark — and materials
that differ in the explanation look visibly different. Quiet palette of stone,
clay, wood, and metal tones over the warm-white ground, with one or two
desaturated accents that each keep a single meaning throughout the plate.
Contemporary editorial typography: one calm display face for the title, one
highly legible face for the many small labels, sentence case, crisply printed
and correctly spelled. Annotation is dense and disciplined — leader lines,
brackets, dimension marks, magnified inset circles, small side studies — laid
out so no two leaders cross. Asymmetric composition with about a quarter of the
page left quiet. Modern printing on clean stock: fresh, crisp, and unaged. The
only lettering anywhere on the plate is the title, the deck, the labels, and the
short notes. The words hero, drawing, figure, plate, inset, zone, band, strip,
trio, column, and cutaway describe the construction of the page and are never
lettered onto it, alone or in a phrase: no headings that name parts of the
layout, no percentages or
proportions of the page, no tags in brackets after a label or note, no sentence
describing the drawing or explaining what the reader is meant to see, no
signature, monogram, date, watermark, or credit line.

The plate is headed "prompt", with the standing line "Turns one seed into words, fills five prompt files from them, and asks a writing model to enrich the result." beneath it.

The dominant picture, filling roughly half the page, shows A left-to-right machine. At left a single seed token feeds a splitter that cuts it into short hexadecimal slices. Each slice drops onto its own numbered word list drawn as a thin stack of cards; a pointer rides down the stack and lifts one card out. Seventeen such lists fan in a shallow arc, their lifted words collecting on a rail that carries them right into a stack of template sheets, where blank slots fill with the chosen words. One filled sheet plus a persona sheet travels along a single line to a remote writing model drawn as a small boxed endpoint, and one enriched sheet returns along the same line.

Magnified circles set beside it show circle one, one hexadecimal slice read as a number, divided into a fraction, multiplied by the list length to land on one entry. circle two, the persona sheet with the enhancement instruction appended beneath it, forming the system context. circle three, a template file stamped into a mirror copy and refilled from that copy at every call.

Colour is used so that Ochre marks the seed and every word derived from it. Teal marks template files and their filled text. Vermillion marks the single network call and the paths that avoid or fail it.

Draw these quantities as dimension marks or counts: 17 word lists feeding 17 attributes; 5 prompt files sent to a model; 2 templates that never leave the machine; 3 ways the call is bypassed; default seed 1337; temperature 0.2; 60 second deadline; 1 ledger row per completed call.

These trade words appear on the plate, each set against the thing it names: seed on the input token; hex slice on the cut piece; fraction and list index inside the selection circle; noun, emotion, occupation, action, place, trope on individual word lists; author context on the persona sheet; enhance.md on the appended instruction; image.md, terse.md, author.md, technical.md on the finished sheets; enhanced prompt on the returning sheet; data sidecar and title line on the two that stay behind; ledger row on the accounting slip; gpt-5.5 on the endpoint box.

Letter these words onto the drawings, spelled exactly as given: seed, hex slice, word lists, noun, emotion, occupation, action, place, trope, writing model fraction, list index, chosen word, author context, enhance.md no-enhance switch, no credentials, empty author, original returned image.md, terse.md, author.md, technical.md, enhanced prompt, data sidecar, ledger row gpt-5.5, seed 1337, temperature 0.2, 60 seconds

Set these short notes beside what they explain: One seed fixes every chosen word; Same seed, same words, every run. Files refill from the mirror each call; Literary work appends the instruction to persona. Any of three checks returns the prompt untouched; Empty reply also returns the original prompt. Data sidecar and title never reach a model; One ledger row per call with usage. Zero seed and zero temperature are omitted.
